Class StatisticsTracker

java.lang.Object
traffic.sim.StatisticsTracker
public class StatisticsTracker extends Object
Records per-cycle KPIs. Phase 1 used a single set of cumulative counters; Phase 2 adds parallel "phase 1" and "phase 2" accumulators so a single running simulation can compute a fair before/after improvement when the user flips the Phase toggle mid-run. (The headless comparison runner instead uses two separate simulations and reads the cumulative counters from each.)
